titleEn: When Thunder Rumbles, Under the Roof!

pages.text: "Mumu, look at the sky! It's black!" They were counting shells on Taro's porch. Though it was daytime, the yard looked dark as evening.
Rumble, boom! Thunder sounded. "I'll go see! I want to see the flashes up close." Taro hurried to the porch's edge.
As Taro put a foot into the yard, flash! Mumu folded their ears and tugged his waist cord. "No! Under the roof!"
Taro's Mom stopped her work on the porch. "When thunder sounds, come farther in, where there are walls." She took them to the inner part of the porch.
Rain blew onto the porch's edge. The floor had wet and dry patches. Mumu swept a hand over the inner dry space. "Come here, inside the walls."

Taro sat in the dry spot. "One, under the roof when thunder rumbles! Two, don't go under a big tree! Three, don't go out until it stops!" Together, they called, "When Thunder Rumbles, Under the Roof!"
Flash, rumble! White streams of rain poured into the yard. Sitting in the dry spot, they counted drops falling from the eaves. Under the roof was dry and not scary at all.
The rain grew quieter, and thunder moved farther away. Taro tapped the porch twice with his branch. "Mom, can we go out now?"
Only after the rain grew light did they enter the yard. "One, under the roof! Two, not under trees! Three, don't go out until it stops!" The next time the sky darkened, Taro ran under the roof first.
Mom hugged Taro. "You waited through the scary sounds so well." During thunder, under the roof was the best place. Taro raised his shoulders proudly. "When Thunder Rumbles, Under the Roof!"
